pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with moderately sharp pixel gradients at the edges; spatial area is maximal on the mid-flank and decreases significantly toward the lower limbs and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-pigmented corridors forming a topological grid; junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radiate and quadri-radiate intersections with consistent pixel thickness across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck mane, characterized by short, uniform vertical protrusions against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, large semi-spherical mass/protuberance located on the ventral surface posterior to the front limb; a second smaller, dark-colored nodule is visible further back on the ventral line.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a Red-billed Oxpecker perched on the upper rump/dorsal ridge; second avian subject visible near the ventral-posterior region.
